remarks: Welcome to 31 Bethany Drive, a beautifully reimagined transitional farmhouse in Irvine’s highly sought-after Turtle Rock community, where timeless elegance meets modern luxury and effortless Southern California living. This stunning 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence offers approximately 1,820 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, featuring gorgeous European oak flooring, elegant black French doors, and an abundance of natural light.
